description: Expected bytes are derived by hand from the rule text. produces[], consumes[] and task_state become asc:produces, asc:consumes and asc:taskState, one triple per name, every one a plain xsd:string literal written bare in Turtle and explicitly in N-Quads (AGSC-05-30, AGSC-05-31 form c), and verdict_digest is never exported. The expectation is the whole file, so the two objects of asc:produces can be checked against AGSC-05-10(d)'s ' , ' object separator and their code-point order ('events' before 'metrics') rather than being read out of a fragment.
